The ten-pair margin remains 1.10; no observations were excluded or replaced.
Steady/catch-up use one streaming subscription, and copy controls use three; busy-pool operational tests and prior sixteen-subscription diagnostics are separate.
Slots have independent queues, not a global FIFO, and do not reserve memory.
Production package qualification, both native architectures and release soak are separate gates.
